### Prepare for Battle!
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/prepare-for-battle-powerpoint-apr-7-2010-11628575.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 17:37
Points:
- Biblical heroes were not born with instant readiness for great tasks.
- David fought smaller, isolated battles defending his sheep long before meeting Goliath.
- Daily faithfulness in obscure places trains believers for spiritual warfare.
- Facing routine challenges today builds confidence for giant battles tomorrow.

### The Cause
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-june-17-2020.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 17:29
Points:
- David refused to shrink back when his older brother Eliab questioned his motives.
- Recognizing the threat to God's honor, David saw a cause worth fighting for.
- True faith moves a believer from passive hesitation to bold, self-sacrificing action.
- Every Christian must ask what godly cause calls for their stand today.

### When I Question God’s Plan
Author: Leah DiPascal
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-march-9-2017.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 17:29
Points:
- Misunderstandings and painful criticism can lead believers to question their purpose.
- David experienced family rejection and years of struggle before reaching the throne.
- Delays and hardships serve as God’s training ground rather than signs of failure.
- God remains faithful to complete the good work He began in our lives.

### Facing Your Giants
Author: Heidi St. John
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-september-21-2017.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 17:37
Points:
- David was completely outmatched by human standards, but his trust rested in God.
- Instead of obsessing over Goliath's size, David focused on God's greatness.
- Severe trials and sudden life crises tempt believers to surrender to fear.
- We can step forward even when afraid, trusting God's power to deliver us.
